observations: The Windows Server sign-in article still both excludes Conditional Access with the extension and describes enforcing it. Client/device-policy caveats do not explicitly reconcile the blanket exclusion.
Hyper-V sockets documents transport prerequisites, not a current supported end-to-end SSH Direct guest setup.
resolution_evidence_needed: Microsoft must specify the supported server/client/extension/authentication combination and scope of the exclusion.
A current Microsoft-supported host/guest/package/command recipe or explicit retirement/support statement is needed.

observations: The transport reference still lacks a supported end-to-end SSH Direct guest recipe. AZ-802 remains the documented path after AZ-800/AZ-801 retire.
resolution_evidence_needed: Obtain a supported current host/guest recipe; keep SSH-over-IP distinct from SSH Direct.

observations: The knowledge article denies Opportunity Agent custom-field support and immediately instructs adding those fields.
Close Agent management stops in-process work, while setup says existing orchestrations continue after deactivation.
resolution_evidence_needed: Clarify agent type, feature stage and supported custom fields.
Clarify whether Stop and deactivation differ, and document the disposition of already-running work.

observations: The policy permits a two-year recovery window, while the restore-frequency table covers only days 0–365 and the prose refers to weeks 2–52.
The central retirement page still gives November 30, 2026 for MS-102.
resolution_evidence_needed: Publish recovery-point intervals for each workload in days 366–730; do not extrapolate first-year intervals.

observations: The same second-year recovery-frequency gap as MS-102 remains.
resolution_evidence_needed: Use the shared Backup clarification; a longer retention setting does not establish a second-year restore-point interval.

observations: The Contact Center migration plan uses September 30, 2026 for new-customer number restrictions; its deprecation ledger uses September 23. Existing-resource and existing-number eligibility statements also differ.
resolution_evidence_needed: Confirm the applicable service, tenant/resource/number cohort and acquisition/port-in cutoff through authoritative service guidance before planning an affected action.

observations: The creation guide forbids changing clustering policy; the 2025-07-01 update contract allows changes from NoCluster and architecture adds a geo-replication restriction.
resolution_evidence_needed: Publish one supported migration recipe identifying source/target policy, API version, replication/module constraints, availability and data-loss implications.

observations: The platform overview still calls private-channel Flow bot support unfinished. The newer dated developer update says private channels are supported through Power Automate and describes Teams-app rollout. Historical paragraphs on that same announcement remain.
resolution_evidence_needed: Reconcile bot versus user identity, portal versus Teams entry point, cloud and rollout cohort. Do not promote a planned rollout date to observed tenant delivery.

observations: The authentication/access summary gives 25–30%, but its detailed heading gives 20–25% in the same current outline.
resolution_evidence_needed: Microsoft must correct the conflicting domain weights; retain the caveat and cover the objective content.

observations: The Continuous/NRT supported-table list includes Sentinel tables; unified hunting known issues still excludes Sentinel NRT.
Table-management text says moving to Lake tier stops Advanced Hunting; September and unified-hunting guidance describe lake access with onboarding-cohort and retention restrictions.
resolution_evidence_needed: Clarify exact table/cloud/cohort eligibility for Sentinel continuous custom detection.
Reconcile lake-only versus extended Analytics retention and the September 23 onboarding boundary, with an explicit supported query path.

observations: The skills heading and change log use October 28, 2026; the credential announcement uses October 14.
resolution_evidence_needed: Microsoft must reconcile the effective date. Keep accepted historical snapshots unchanged until the applicable revision is established.

observations: The exam prerequisite list still includes MB-280 and PL-200; the credential list omits them. A source-only check cannot determine whether an individual historical award satisfies eligibility.
resolution_evidence_needed: Obtain authoritative eligibility clarification for the disputed credentials and award dates; no account-specific eligibility claim.

observations: The connector procedure includes SAP, while the limitations enumerate Dataverse, Salesforce, Oracle and Zendesk without SAP.
resolution_evidence_needed: Clarify current SAP prompt-data support and its runtime/connector conditions.

observations: Native HSR groups nodes into one logical backup item and tracks the primary; the FAQ recommends stopping protection on a secondary and resuming when primary without clearly identifying a different protection model.
resolution_evidence_needed: Identify which protection model the FAQ recipe applies to before executing any stop/resume procedure.
